OverlaySafety.DesktopNotice.zh: 全屏增强不可用，已回退到普通桌面模式。绘画和文件功能仍可使用；部分全屏应用上方可能无法显示。
OverlaySafety.DesktopNotice.en: Fullscreen enhancement is unavailable. Ordinary desktop mode keeps drawing and file operations available; coverage above some fullscreen applications may be limited.

OverlaySafety.RecoverFailed.zh: 无法完成自动回退。请保存画布后退出，并使用 --desktop-mode 重新启动浮绘。
OverlaySafety.RecoverFailed.en: Automatic fallback could not finish. Save your canvas, exit, and restart FloatCanvas with --desktop-mode.
